data.rationale: The proposal follows the right Booking → Xe → Mail flow in the right order, but it has four problems: it leaves out the rule to pick the first hotel scored 8 or more; it treats derived values (hotel_name, price_eur) as inputs; it uses an unnamed {name} placeholder instead of tying the recipient to {traveler}@example.com; and it tells the automation to Send, when the user explicitly discarded the email.
